name: clean-road-regional
about: A sound text-only ad: an empty road through wheat at sunrise, the words at the top on the kit's navy plate. Our overlay (top_band) over the checker's clean-empty-road photo.

truth.how: nothing planted: the headline is about the road and the picture is the road

subject_legible.reason: A straight road through open farmland at sunset is immediately clear and striking at any screen size.

words_match_picture.reason: The headline 'regional runs through farm country' maps directly onto a road cutting through golden farm fields — a perfect visual match.

hierarchy_reads.reason: The dark navy panel behind the headline gives strong contrast, but 'Apply today' sits inside the same panel styled like a sub-line rather than a distinct tappable button, weakening the call-to-action hierarchy.

looks_like_kit.reason: The deep navy (#1F3A5F) panel and white text match the brand colours exactly, though no logo is present and there is no secondary accent to reinforce identity further.
